"https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/n8n/49e569f0-503e-4e42-a1ba-7e63684e90d3", "applyUrl": "https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/n8n/49e569f0-503e-4e42-a1ba-7e63684e90d3/application", "descriptionHtml": "

The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination.

n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we\u2019re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.

Since our founding in 2019, we\u2019ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we\u2019ve:

  • Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders

  • Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world\u2019s Top 40 most popular projects

  • Backed by top investors, from Sequoia\u2019s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation


That\u2019s the company we\u2019ve built. Now we\u2019d love to see what you can build. If you\u2019re applying, try n8n out - whether you\u2019re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register.

We\u2019re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

\ud83c\udfaf Your main goal will be to identify and reduce security risks across n8n's product and internal systems, using threat modelling, hands-on security expertise, and cross-functional collaboration to help teams design, build, and operate more secure systems.

You'll join our growing security team at a pivotal stage, acting as a trusted security partner to teams across the business. You'll help us build a move from reactive security management to a proactive, scalable security practice.

Here's what you'll be driving:

Threat Modelling, Risk Assessment & Security Design

  • Conduct threat modelling and risk assessments across product features, AI agents, cloud infrastructure, corporate IT, internal applications, and data systems, identifying vulnerabilities and recommending practical mitigations.

  • Partner with Engineering, Cloud, IT, and Data teams to review security designs, define actionable security requirements, and influence the implementation of appropriate controls.

  • Help teams embed security into their development processes through secure coding guidance, design reviews, documentation, and security tooling that enables them to identify and address risks independently.

Vulnerability Management & Coordinated Disclosure

  • Participate in the security triage rotation, assessing incoming vulnerability reports, validating findings, and prioritising remediation based on severity and business impact.

  • Collaborate with engineering teams to coordinate vulnerability remediation, verify fixes, and support secure patch and release processes.

  • Help manage our vulnerability disclosure and bug bounty programmes, including engagement with security researchers, coordinated disclosures, and GitHub Security Advisories.

Security Operations & Incident Readiness

  • Help establish and improve logging, detection, and protective monitoring capabilities across our infrastructure, corporate systems, and internal applications.

  • Develop and improve incident response processes, runbooks, and exercises to strengthen our ability to detect, investigate, and respond to security incidents.

  • Work closely with system owners to identify security gaps, prioritise remediation, and verify that implemented controls effectively reduce risk.

Customer Trust & Compliance Engineering

  • Support SOC 2 compliance by helping establish continuous control monitoring, automated evidence collection, and processes that make security assurance part of everyday operations.

  • Collaborate with Sales, Solutions Engineering, and Customer Success to respond to customer security assessments and build reusable resources that streamline future requests.

  • Partner with Legal, Finance, IT, and other stakeholders to assess security risks, improve security policies and controls, and strengthen trust with enterprise customers.

We're hiring two Security Engineers with complementary strengths, so you don't need to be an expert in every security domain.

REQUIREMENTS

Must-haves

  • \ud83d\udd0d Threat Modelling & Risk Assessment: You have hands-on experience assessing real-world systems, identifying security risks, determining defensible severity levels, and recommending practical controls that teams can implement.

  • \ud83d\udee0\ufe0f Technical Security Expertise: You can validate security findings, reproduce vulnerabilities, develop proof-of-concepts, and write code or automation when needed to demonstrate risks or improve security processes.

  • \ud83d\udd10 Security Engineering Experience: You've worked hands-on in infrastructure, product, or application security within a product-focused organisation, with a strong understanding of how modern systems are designed and secured.

  • \ud83e\udd1d Cross-functional Influence: You're comfortable acting as an internal security consultant, advising teams, challenging technical decisions constructively, and influencing stakeholders without direct authority.

  • \ud83c\udfaf Risk Remediation & Ownership: You've helped secure systems you don't directly own, translating security findings into actionable requirements and working with responsible teams to ensure effective remediation.

  • \ud83e\udd16 AI & LLM Fluency: You're comfortable using LLM-assisted tooling and understand its limitations, security implications, and potential failure modes.

  • \u270d\ufe0f Clear Communication: You can explain complex security risks, document technical findings, and provide practical guidance that engineers and non-technical stakeholders can confidently act on.

You also bring deep expertise in at least two of the following areas:

  • \ud83d\udcbb Application Security: You've developed security checks, engineering guardrails, tooling, or guidance that helps product teams build and ship secure software.

  • \u2601\ufe0f Platform Security: You have experience securing a major cloud provider and Kubernetes environments, including areas such as sandboxing, multi-tenancy, or identity.

  • \ud83d\udd11 Corporate Security: You've worked on identity and access management, endpoint security, employee access lifecycles, or data access controls across corporate environments.

  • \ud83d\udea8 Security Monitoring: You've implemented logging, protective monitoring, or security detection capabilities that support effective investigation and incident response.

  • \ud83d\udccb Security Assurance & Compliance: You've supported SOC 2 or ISO 27001 from an engineering perspective, including implementing technical controls or automating compliance evidence collection.

Nice-to-haves

  • \ud83d\udc1b Vulnerability Disclosure: You've helped operate bug bounty or coordinated vulnerability disclosure programmes, including publishing security advisories such as GHSAs or CVEs.

  • \ud83e\udde0 AI & Agent Security: You have experience assessing or securing LLM-powered applications and AI agents, including risks related to permissions, tool access, prompt injection, or sensitive data.

  • \ud83c\udfe2 Corporate IT Tooling: You're familiar with platforms such as Okta, Azure, or Drata and their role in securing corporate systems and supporting compliance.

  • \ud83c\udf0d Open-source Ecosystems: You've worked with open-source or source-available products, contributed to security communities, or are already familiar with n8n.

  • \ud83c\udfaf Penetration Testing: You have practical penetration testing experience and can independently identify, demonstrate, and help remediate security vulnerabilities.

  • \ud83c\udf31 Early-stage Security Experience: You've been an early security hire or helped establish security practices in a startup or rapidly scaling organisation.

Why join us?

At n8n, you'll help shape security at a defining stage of our growth. We're building a security practice that goes beyond reacting to vulnerabilities, and you'll play a key role in how we identify risks, influence engineering decisions, and establish security practices that scale with the business.

You'll work across a broad range of challenges, from securing AI-powered product features and our source-available automation platform to improving corporate security, strengthening incident readiness, and making compliance more automated. You'll have direct exposure to teams across the company, the opportunity to influence important technical decisions, and the autonomy to turn your expertise into measurable security improvements.

Sound like a challenge you're excited to take on?

Apply now \u2014 and help us build the future of secure automation.

n8n is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

We can sponsor visas to Germany; for any other country, you need to have existing right to work.

Our company language is English.

You care about diversity and inclusion? We do too! Check out our Diversity, Inclusion and Belonging initiatives at n8n (https://www.notion.so/n8n/Diversity-inclusion-and-belonging-n8n-c1bec2fff536422d868b1a438d990e35).

Location disclaimer: If you see multiple job postings for the same role, it is most likely because we're hiring remotely for this role and posting in different locations to make sure every potential candidate can see the role. Please apply to the location you're the most likely to work from in the future.

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation \ud83d\udcb8 \u2013 We offer fair and attractive pay.

  • Ownership \ud83d\udcaa \u2013 Our core value is to \u201cempower others,\u201d and we mean it\u2014you\u2019ll get a slice of n8n with equity.

  • Work/life balance \ud83c\udfd6\ufe0f \u2013 We work hard but ensure you have time to recharge:

    • Europe: 30 days of vacation, plus public holidays wherever you are.

    • US: 20 vacation days, 8 sick days, plus public holidays wherever you are.

  • Health & wellness \ud83e\ude7a \u2013

    • Europe: We provide benefits according to local country norms.*

    • US: Multiple low-premium, low-deductible medical plans with coverage for individuals and families\u2014plus a no-cost premium HDHP option with a pre-seeded HSA\u2014along with dental and vision coverage.

  • Future planning \ud83d\udcb0 \u2013

    • Europe: We provide pension contributions according to local country norms.*

    • US: 401(k) retirement plan with a 4% employer match.

  • Financial security \ud83d\udee1\ufe0f \u2013

    • Europe: We provide benefits according to local country norms.*

    • US: Company-paid short-term and long-term disability insurance, plus life insurance to support you and your loved ones.

  • Career growth \ud83d\udcc8 \u2013 We hire rising stars who grow with us! You\u2019ll get \u20ac1K (or equivalent) per year to spend on courses, books, events, or coaching to level up your skills.

  • A passionate team \ud83e\udd29 \u2013 We love our product, and we prove it with regular hackathons where we see who can build the coolest thing with it!

  • Remote-first \ud83c\udf0f \u2013 Our team works remotely across Europe, with regular off-sites for team bonding. Some roles, like sales in the US, are hybrid\u2014please check the job description.

  • Giving back \ud83e\udd1d \u2013 We're big fans of open source, and you'll get $100 per month to support projects you care about.

  • Transparency \ud83d\ude4f \u2013 We all know what everyone\u2019s working on, how the company is doing\u2014the whole shebang.

*Country and/or State specific details provided in your employment agreement.

We\u2019re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

We\u2019re now looking for a Sales Enablement Manager to make sure our GTM team scales just as fast - and just as effectively.

\ud83c\udfaf Your main goal will be to enable GTM teams to close more deals faster by providing the knowledge, resources, and training they need to succeed at every stage of the buyer journey.

You\u2019ll be helping us build on early-stage existing foundations (onboarding, certifications, tooling) and take it to the next level as we scale. This is a high-impact, hands-on role with a direct line to revenue outcomes.

\u00a0

\ud83d\ude80 Build onboarding that shortens ramp time and boosts impact

  • Design and deliver world-class onboarding for new GTM team members across Sales, Customer Success, and Solutions Engineering.

  • Track and continuously improve ramp time through tailored strategies and performance feedback loops.

  • Collaborate with leadership to define what \u201cgreat\u201d looks like across roles and build onboarding paths accordingly.

\ud83d\udcda Create scalable enablement programs that drive revenue

  • Translate product updates, GTM strategies, and technical concepts into clear, actionable content.

  • Identify knowledge gaps and build role-specific enablement initiatives to address them.

  • Design certifications and training frameworks (e.g. demo, discovery, technical proficiency) to ensure consistency and quality across the field.

\ud83c\udfa4 Run high-impact enablement events and internal comms

  • Support the planning and execution of team-wide enablement moments like SKOs, regional kickoffs, and quarterly readiness sessions, partnering closely with sales and revenue leadership on strategy and messaging.

  • Act as the voice of enablement for GTM teams, making sure they have the right information at the right time, through the right channels.

  • Partner closely with Product, Product Marketing, and RevOps to sync launches, messaging, and process changes.

\ud83d\udcca Measure what matters and make enablement a growth driver

  • Define and track KPIs to demonstrate enablement\u2019s impact on sales productivity, pipeline velocity, and deal size.

  • Build a competency scorecard with GTM managers to support coaching and performance management.

  • Use insights from sales calls, Gong data, and product usage to continuously refine your programs.

REQUIREMENTS

Must-haves

About the Leadership Talent Pool

At n8n, we\u2019re always excited to connect with exceptional leaders who are passionate about building, scaling, and empowering teams to achieve ambitious goals.
This Leadership Talent Pool is not for a specific open role\u2014it\u2019s a way for us to stay in touch with high-impact professionals who could be a strong fit for future leadership opportunities across our global teams.

Whether your expertise lies in GTM, Product, Engineering, Operations, or People, we\u2019d love to hear from you.

What You\u2019ll Bring

  • Proven track record of leading and developing high-performing teams, in a fast-growing environment.

  • Ability to set strategic direction, translate it into actionable goals, and drive execution.

  • Strong communicator who builds trust and alignment across functions and cultures.

  • Data-informed mindset, with the ability to balance analytical thinking and creativity in decision-making.

  • Passion for building inclusive, empowering, and high-accountability team cultures.

  • Experience scaling processes, org structures, and talent systems during growth or transformation phases.

What We Value

  • A leadership style rooted in empathy, transparency, and ownership.

  • Curiosity about automation, workflow orchestration, and AI-driven innovation.

  • A commitment to impact over ego: you care deeply about results, but even more about how they\u2019re achieved.

  • Comfort with ambiguity, adaptability, and a proactive approach to problem-solving.

Why Join the Talent Pool

By joining the n8n Leadership Talent Pool, you\u2019ll stay on our radar for future Director, Head of, or VP-level opportunities as we continue to grow.
If your background aligns with an upcoming role, our team will reach out directly to start the conversation.

    • Europe: We provide benefits according to local country norms.*

  • Career growth \ud83d\udcc8 \u2013 We hire rising stars who grow with us! You\u2019ll get \u20ac1K (or equivalent) per year to spend on courses, books, events, or coaching to level up your skills.

  • A passionate team \ud83e\udd29 \u2013 We love our product, and we prove it with regular hackathons where we see who can build the coolest thing with it!
